text:
erin_sales: Handoff: Borealis Clinical pilot signed (60d). PO in, legal requested a BAA + SOC2 artifacts. Go-live goal 2025-10-06. Requirements: HIPAA-safe private control plane (preferred) or dedicated reserved GPUs, SAML SSO, audit export to Splunk, HSM-backed keys, and a clinical feedback loop for prompt quality. Customer contact: kate@borealis.health. Pack: https://drive.red/borealis-pilot

mina_cs: I'll run onboarding + clinician enablement. Quick clarifiers: 1) They want clinician feedback captured in-app to feed our quality dashboard — can we wire a webhook? 2) Retention: they asked 24 months for audit logs.

erin_sales: Yes to feedback webhook (they'll post to a secure endpoint we provide). Retention 24 months is requested but may be an add-on. No inbound model fine-tuning during pilot.

raj_support: Opening infra ticket. Need SAML metadata (IdP XML), customer VPC CIDR for peering, Splunk HEC endpoint + token or S3 destination, signed BAA, and customer webhook URL for feedback ingestion. ETA to provision private plane: ~3 business days after artifacts.

oliver_eng: Perf sizing note: expected peak 10 concurrent clinician sessions, avg 550 tokens/session. If we want p99 <250ms during clinic blocks, recommend a warmed dedicated pool 0700-1900 local clinic TZ. Also request a small eval set (30-60 prompts) and a set of critical prompts (top 12) for quality gating.

mina_cs: Action owners: CS = mina_cs (onboard + clinician enablement + feedback), Support = raj_support (infra + tickets), Eng = oliver_eng (capacity + perf sims + rollout canary), Security = tess_security (BAA + HSM + intake review), Sales = erin_sales (contracts + artifacts). I'll assemble a runbook and patient-safe prompt set with the customer.

mina_cs: Onboarding checklist to send to customer:
```
- Signed BAA (scan) to security@redwood.com
- SAML IdP metadata XML (IdP cert + ACS URL)
- VPC CIDR for peering + peering contact
- Splunk HEC endpoint + token OR S3 bucket ARN
- HSM KMS details (customer-managed key ok)
- Feedback webhook URL + auth method
- Eval prompt set (30-60 prompts) + critical 12 prompts
- Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 24-48h windows
```

tess_security: Will review BAA/DPA and their security questionnaire. HSM requirement accepted; provisioning HSM adds ~3 business days. Also need to confirm data minimization/tokenization spec for clinician notes.

erin_sales: Customer will provide SAML metadata and webhook by COB; sending drive link for their security pack now.

infra-bot: ticket CS-9907 created by raj_support - infra.provision.privateplane

raj_support: Scheduling technical kickoff Tue 2025-09-23 10:00am PT (placeholder). Please confirm internal attendees. We will not invite customer until artifacts appear in ticket.

oliver_eng: Perf plan: once eval set is in, I'll run perf sims for q8 and non-quant variants, measure latency and quality delta on the 12 critical prompts. If quality drop >2% on top clinical prompts, we will run canary on non-quant variant. Also will estimate KV cache sizing given avg session lengths.

mina_cs: Clinical feedback capture: we'll provide a lightweight widget that posts anonymized feedback to their webhook; we will instrument acceptance rate, helpfulness score, and flag prompts for review. CS will own weekly quality review with product and eng.

erin_sales: Renewal risk: medium — pilot is gating a full contract. Key risks: delays in BAA/HSM setup, webhook/SHC integration, or any latency impacting clinician workflow. Sales will monitor customer sentiment and flag any concerns.

mina_cs: Health & escalation plan: weekly health sync Fridays. Set health flag "onboarding: waiting for artifacts" until we have SAML + BAA. If infra/security blockers exceed 6 business days, escalate to Head of CS and VP Eng. If webhook integration slips and blocks clinician testing >5 business days, escalate to CRO.

tess_security: Also request their SOC2 report and internal contact for security questionnaire. Will post required changes to the ticket.

erin_sales: Looping customer in now to request SAML metadata, BAA, and webhook endpoint. I'll update thread when artifacts arrive. Thanks team :pray:
